Behold, the conceptual manifestation of "Excavation" and "Dismantling." The Red Matter Morning Star is a weapon of absolute blunt-force trauma, so astronomically dense and powerful that a single charged swing can smash right through dimensional boundaries. But brute force is not its only defining trait. Thanks to an incredibly sophisticated NBT-matrix update, this omni-tool can seamlessly shift its molecular structure to become absolutely any tool you desire.

Functionally, this is the absolute final mining tool you will ever need to craft. It combines the functions of a Pickaxe, Shovel, and Hammer, instantly annihilating vast areas of stone, dirt, and ore when fully charged.

But the true magic lies in its corporate firmware! The Morning Star seamlessly acts as a GregTech Wrench and a Wire Cutter! You can now violently terraform the earth and delicately dismantle your complex high-voltage machine setups and AE2 cables, all with the exact same god-tier artifact. Equivalent Exchange has truly conquered GregTech!
